quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing (company): the internet-company data-center MPO fiber jumper and accessories project began execution in June 2026 with an expected one-year execution period. In marine, 500kV-class cable was over 40% of marine revenue in H1 after delivery of the Yangjiang Sanshan Island ±500kV DC and 500kV AC projects; high-voltage subsea cable projects in Germany, Poland and elsewhere in Europe will be delivered mainly in H2; new orders included a Zhejiang 500kV AC cable, a State Grid ±200kV DC cable, a Vietnam subsea cable EPC and Middle East oil-and-gas cables; a Saudi subsea cable plant has started construction, and the Zhongtian Ocean System new plant and the Zhejiang offshore-engineering cable base have come into operation.
quarterly_data.figure: 500kV-class cable over 40% of H1 marine revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: general manager Lu Wei said energy-storage system shipments rose 130% year on year and new-energy overseas revenue rose 76%; power-segment overseas business grew 28%; electronic copper foil revenue rose 63% as the company developed 140μm-210μm ultra-thick foil and completed R&D testing of RTF-3 and HVLP-2 foil for AI servers and optical modules, becoming a main domestic CCL supplier; PI film shipments rose 69%; its solid-state battery pilot line finished commissioning; it launched a mid-to-long-duration liquid-cooled storage system for data centers; and 2000Nm³/h alkaline electrolysers are available for large green-hydrogen bases. It has started building the Nantong optoelectronic computing center.
quarterly_data.figure: storage shipments +130%; electronic copper foil revenue +63%; PI film shipments +69%

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Xue Chi (H1 2026 results briefing): AI is driving incremental fiber and cable demand; citing CRU data, he said related fiber prices have been raised and new effective capacity is coming on more slowly, so the industry supply-demand balance remains tight, and he expects demand for bend-insensitive G.657.A2 fiber in high-density data-center cabling to keep rising.
